data.name: Overnight Sail - 1 Night
data.headline: 2 Days/1 Night Private Charter
data.description: Embark on an unforgettable overnight sail, including a visit to historic Egmont Key, soaking in the sunset on the water, and anchoring near the charming Anna Maria Island. After a day of adventures, enjoy dinner and activities on the island before returning to Second Wind to rest. In the morning, have the option for an early morning coffee and breakfast on Anna Maria Island before starting our sail back to Treasure Island. Max: 6 Guests
data.cancellation_notes:
Customer Cancellation: Cancellations must be requested via call or email no less than 24hrs before trip departure for a full refund. No shows will be charged full price. 

Weather Cancellations: If your trip's departure may be impacted by weather, our captains will reach out via text or email no less than 2hrs before departure with a weather update. Should the trip be canceled, guests are entitled to a full refund.
